# möbius for macOS 0.3.2

Messages from another Bot show their sender and remain visible when they open a turn. Messages received during active work appear inside the work summary.

New chats show a visible Bot selector in the header. Appearance settings offer a color picker, editable HEX value and reset for the current theme, preserving your light and dark choices.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later, and gateway 0.16.2 (protocol 87).
